description: Department of Cooperative Development - claims list of the Kandy District Cooperative Societies.
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the liquidation proceedings of multiple cooperative societies in the Kandy District. It is a call for creditors and members to submit claims against these societies, which are business entities. The content deals with the commercial process of winding up business operations and settling debts, falling squarely under business/commercial matters (company dissolutions and related procedures).
